hero.intro: I'm Bogdan Murășan. I turn a long-standing passion for technology into carefully delivered web and IT services.
hero.description: A free, open-source Astro 7 starter theme to build anything on.

story.heading: From floppy disks and Windows XP to Tech cu Bogdan
paragraphs: My interest in technology started in childhood, in the age of floppy disks. I copied games, experimented with computers and built my own Windows XP installation images.

For years I was, and still am, the person family and friends call when something technical stops working. I have now worked professionally in IT for three years, and Tech cu Bogdan is the next step in developing that experience independently.
I genuinely enjoy the work. I want each service to be built carefully, without taking on more than I can deliver and without treating anything as a given.

design.heading: Web design
paragraphs: Web design is how your website looks and feels: the layout, the colours, the images, and the way visitors find their way around.

I design every website around your business — your brand, your content, and the customers you want to reach — so it makes a strong first impression and guides people straight to what matters. Clean, modern, and made to work on every screen, from a desktop monitor to a phone.

development.heading: Web development
paragraphs: Web development is the building of your website: turning the design into the code that runs in your visitor's browser.

I build with Astro, a modern framework trusted for some of the fastest websites online. That makes your site quick to load, safe, and easy to look after for years to come. And it's yours from day one, with the code, the domain, and the hosting all in your name.

I build speed, SEO, and accessibility in from the very first line, not as an afterthought. That means your website is easy for Google to find and understand, opens fast for every visitor, and can be used by everyone who lands on it.

process.heading: How a project runs
process.lead: From your first message to a live website.

steps.title: First contact
steps.description: You send a message through the contact form. I reply within a working day, and we plan a free, informational talk about what you need. No obligations.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.description: After our talk you get one clear document: what I'll build, when it's ready, and the fixed price. You decide with everything on the table.

steps.title: Design & build
steps.description: I work in short cycles. You follow the progress on a staging link, and you see your website take shape.

steps.title: Launch & support
steps.description: Your website goes live on your own domain and hosting, in your name. Afterwards I stay reachable, and there's a monthly care plan if you want regular updates.

faq.heading: Questions and answers
faq.lead: The things clients ask before we start.

items.question: What does a website cost?
items.answer: Every project gets one fixed price, agreed before we start. No hourly billing, no surprises afterwards. The free talk — and the free check, if there's already a website — tells me what your project needs, and you get the price in one clear proposal.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: That depends on the size of the website. The proposal names the timeline together with the price, so you know both before we start.

items.question: What happens with my current website?
items.answer: It stays online until the new one is ready. Your content, your web address, and your Google rankings come along. I check your current website before our first talk, so you get clear answers from the start.

items.question: Do I need to arrange hosting or a domain?
items.answer: No. I set up the hosting and the domain for you, in your own name. If you already have a domain, we simply keep it.

items.question: Do we need to meet in person?
items.answer: It's not needed. Most projects run entirely by phone, video, and email. I work with clients worldwide, and time zones are rarely a problem.

items.question: Are you a company or agency?
items.answer: I'm a one-person business: a freelancer, not an agency. You work directly with the person doing the work, from the first talk to the finished website. No sales team, no account managers, no handoffs.

items.question: Can I change the website myself after launch?
items.answer: You can simply send me your changes, and the monthly care plan exists exactly for that. If you want to edit the website yourself, say so in the first talk and I set the site up for it.

items.question: Do you also build webshops?
items.answer: No. Big online shops are the one thing I don't build. Everything else that needs a custom Astro website, I build: tell me in the first talk what you have in mind, and I'll be honest about whether I'm the right builder for it.

items.question: Is the website really mine?
items.answer: Completely. The domain, the hosting, and the code are in your name from day one. If you ever want to move on, you take everything with you: you're never locked in.

items.question: What happens if something breaks after launch?
items.answer: Very little can break: the website has no plugins and no database to fail. And I stay reachable after launch; for regular updates and monitoring there is the monthly care plan.

items.description: No response, unexpected shutdowns or stuck during startup.

items.description: Slow startup, freezes or poor response during use.

items.description: Data saving and transfer when the storage can be read safely.

services.heading: From diagnosis to a working device
services.lead: Hardware and software work for laptops and desktops, excluding board-level electronic repairs.

items.title: Diagnostics and component replacement
items.description: I identify the problem, check compatibility and replace modular components such as SSD, RAM, battery, display or keyboard. I do not perform soldering or circuit repairs.

items.title: Windows and software
items.description: Windows, driver and update installation, error remediation, removal of unwanted software and system startup optimisation.

items.title: Upgrades and assembly
items.description: I recommend compatible components for your budget, install SSD or RAM and assemble complete desktop systems.

items.title: Cleaning and maintenance
items.description: Internal cleaning, cooling checks and thermal paste replacement when the model and procedure allow it.

pricing.heading: Know the cost before I begin
pricing.lead: Initial diagnostics are free. The final price is communicated and confirmed before work begins.

rows.service: SSD installation with transfer or cloning

pricing.note: Prices cover labour and may vary by model, complexity and device condition. Parts and software licences are not included.

steps.title: Describe the problem
steps.description: Send the device model and the symptoms you have noticed.

steps.title: Free diagnostic
steps.description: I check the device and establish the likely cause.

steps.title: Approve the work
steps.description: You receive the recommendation and cost before I begin.

steps.title: Repair and test
steps.description: I complete the work, test the result and explain what was done.

items.title: Drop-off by appointment
items.description: The address is not a retail location. Devices are generally brought by the client; collection can be arranged separately in Cluj-Napoca.

items.title: Parts remain in your name
items.description: I recommend compatible components and you normally purchase them directly, keeping the invoice and part warranty in your name.

items.title: Apple devices
items.description: Availability is confirmed after identifying the exact model and assessing the problem. Complex repairs may be referred to a specialist.

items.title: Workmanship warranty
items.description: Labour has a 30-day warranty for the same intervention. Client-purchased parts retain the seller's warranty.

items.question: Is the diagnostic really free?
items.answer: Yes. I inspect the device and explain the problem and options before you decide whether to proceed.

items.question: Do I buy the parts?
items.answer: In most cases, yes. I identify the compatible component, while its invoice and warranty remain directly in your name.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Diagnostics are usually completed within 1–2 business days. Repair time depends on the issue, model and part availability.

items.question: Do you repair logic boards or connectors?
items.answer: I do not perform soldering or board-level electronic repairs. I can diagnose the issue and recommend a specialist when needed.

items.question: Do you accept MacBooks?
items.answer: Yes, for assessment and services compatible with the available experience and tools. Hardware work is confirmed after identifying the model; complex work is referred to a specialist.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Back up your data before service whenever the device allows. Saving or transferring data is possible only when the storage can be read safely.

cta.heading: Tell me what is wrong with your device
cta.description: Send the model, symptoms and, if useful, a few photos. I will tell you the next step.

problems.heading: When it makes sense to have someone manage IT continuously
problems.lead: If these situations look familiar, this is no longer one technical issue. It is about organizing the entire working environment.

items.title: A new colleague needs to be set up
items.description: They need accounts, licences, file access and a correctly configured device from day one.

items.title: Someone has left the team
items.description: Accounts must be closed, permissions revoked and the data they accessed protected.

items.title: You do not know who has access
items.description: Files, applications and administrative accounts are shared without a clear record.

items.title: Every device is configured differently
items.description: Laptops and phones have different settings, updates and levels of protection.

items.title: Backups exist but were never tested
items.description: Copies appear to run, but nobody has verified whether the data can be restored.

items.title: Nobody is responsible for the network
items.description: When Wi-Fi, the router or VPN fail, there is no saved configuration or responsible person.

items.title: You cannot control a lost device
items.description: There is no MDM solution to lock, wipe, enforce rules or revoke access remotely.

items.title: Licences are not tracked
items.description: It is unclear which subscriptions are active, who uses them and whether unused licences are still being paid for.

services.heading: Accounts, devices and core infrastructure
services.lead: The setup follows the client's size and work, without forcing a provider or resold licence bundle.

items.title: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace
items.description: Domains, DNS, users, licences, groups, permissions, security and email or file migrations.

items.title: Onboarding and offboarding
items.description: Creating and revoking access, assigning licences and preparing devices through a documented process.

items.title: Device management
items.description: Policies and enrolment through Intune, Google Endpoint Management, Apple Business Manager, Mosyle or Jamf as appropriate.

items.title: Baseline security and compliance
items.description: MFA, access rules, updates, encryption, device protection and reducing unnecessary privileges.

items.title: Backup and restoration
items.description: Solution selection and setup, alert monitoring and periodic restoration tests without reading client content.

items.title: Basic local network
items.description: Router, Wi-Fi, DHCP, DNS, guest network, firmware, configuration backups and VPN where supported.

steps.title: Implementation and management

items.description: Servers, enterprise firewalls, structured cabling and complex architectures are assessed separately or referred to specialists.

items.description: Hours, response time and included support are defined in the proposal. The service does not imply permanent availability.

items.question: Is the service only for companies?
items.answer: No. It also suits independent professionals, designers, lawyers, surveyors, practices, offices and non-profits.

items.question: Must I buy licences from you?
items.answer: No. The client buys licences and subscriptions directly. I recommend, configure and manage the selected solution.

items.question: Can you manage both Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace?
items.answer: Yes. The platform follows the client's workflow, requirements and budget rather than a resold package.

items.question: Which MDM platforms can you use?
items.answer: Microsoft Intune, Google Endpoint Management, Apple Business Manager with Mosyle or Jamf, depending on devices and licences.

items.question: Does backup monitoring guarantee data recovery?
items.answer: No absolute guarantee exists. Monitoring checks execution, alerts and restoration through periodic tests, reducing the risk of an undetected failed backup.

items.question: How is this different from IT support?
items.answer: IT support resolves one-off user requests. IT management continuously manages accounts, devices, policies, backup and core infrastructure.
